Grade: Grade 1

Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Effective Communication By the end of the sub-strand, LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Effective Communication By the end of the sub-strand, LISTENING. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

2. Explain Effective Communication By the end of the sub-strand, LISTENING to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Effective Communication By the end of the sub-strand, LISTENING.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Effective Communication By the end of the sub-strand, LISTENING with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Effective Communication By the end of the sub-strand, LISTENING important for a Grade 1 learner?
